control.decision: Retain as the rollback control until promotion gates pass.

role_hypotheses.reason: Luna remains contract-clean, very fast, and inexpensive with a direct provider path. Llama 4 Maverick and GLM 5.2 were the strongest clean open-weight screens, but require blind review and a separate self-hosting study.
Terra had the strongest earlier latency tail but did not beat Luna's automated signal. Grok, GLM, and Llama were clean in the expanded suite. Only blind teaching-quality review can justify a winner.

Llama was clean with a 2.912-second p50 and low routed cost. GLM and MiniMax were also clean. This does not select a self-hosted deployment; total infrastructure, license, privacy, quantization, and reliability must be tested separately.

The newer premium systems produced no better deterministic signal than Sonnet, Luna, Grok, GLM, Llama, or MiniMax. Advance them only if sampled blind review establishes a material naturalness or teaching gain worth their latency and cost.

All three passed the text-grounding screen or automated answer checks, but the Flash and Qwen-style reasoning budgets exposed length risks and no multimodal suite has run. Preview status also prevents Gemini Pro from being the only route.

None of the expensive ceiling models improved the corrected deterministic signal on this bounded workload. Keep only a small blind-review sample unless a harder suite establishes a real advantage; never auto-publish offline content.

expanded_screen_decisions.notes: Qwen 3.7 Flash and Qwen 3.6 became usable at a 4,000-token budget, but the added reasoning latency/token use removed their expected efficiency advantage. Qwen 3.7 Plus had 11 length finishes at the common 1,200-token contract.

reasoning_effort_decision.reason: The separate low-effort treatment did not improve Luna or Terra and had worse p95 latency in this run.

provider_path_decision.reason: Both paths were healthy; direct OpenAI had a tighter GPT latency tail in the 72-call calibration run.

required_before_runtime_registry_change: two independent qualified Chamorro reviews and adjudication
at least 100 held-out independently authored integrated cases
dedicated multimodal evaluation for any vision route
startup model-ID validation and returned-provider logging
feature flag, shadow, canary, and tested control rollback
